==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am riding on the back of a white horse. I am traveling rapidly through a series of colorful, interdimensional tunnels. The horse seems to be guided by my fear.

The horse travels through a series of colorful waterfalls. Between each waterfall is a corridor representing another world. I feel a sense of familiarity as I pass through each one.

The horse vanishes and I find myself in a world where black goo warps the minds of men. Before I can do anything, I hear what sounds like a man talking in the waking world. I wake up, but no one is there.
